records.csv_project_name: Design Services for Campus Wide Assessment
records.title: Design Services for Campus Wide Assessment
records.project_scope: Campus-wide assessment and feasibility study for converting the University of New Mexico heating infrastructure from steam-based systems to electrified low-temperature hot water solutions. Scope includes comparative concepts for individual-building conversions and combined building hubs; routing and siting of plants; interconnections, looped distribution configurations, temperature/pressure regimes and controls; preliminary alignment drawings with utility and roadway crossings; resiliency, isolation and phased cutover strategies; evaluation of ties to existing plants or future energy centers; assessment of electric heat sources such as heat recovery chillers, ambient loop heat pumps, thermal storage and electric boilers. At building level, the consultant must review records and perform field walkthroughs for identified buildings, classify them as Green/Yellow/Red based on conversion complexity, identify residual steam loads, develop DHW strategies, and prepare schematic flow diagrams and control narratives. Additional tasks include high-level load analysis, option comparison including NPV, carbon impact and electrical capacity implications, phasing plans, and Class 4/5 opinions of probable cost.
records.services: Professional A/E design and assessment services including feasibility and concept study, campus energy infrastructure planning, civil engineering input for distribution corridors and crossings, rehabilitation/refurbishment planning, mechanical engineering, architecture/interior/space planning support, programming, phasing and cost analysis.

records.title: A/E for Statewide Boating Access - North Shore
records.project_location: Put-In-Bay, Ottawa County, Ohio, USA; includes South Bass Island State Park and East Harbor State Park.
records.project_scope: The project covers design improvements for boating access facilities at multiple state park sites on Ohio's North Shore. At South Bass Island State Park boat launch, the scope includes improvements to the launch ramp, protective pier, and adjacent shoreline to improve safety, accessibility, and operational capacity; development of alternatives for widening the ramp to allow two simultaneous launch lanes; and recommendation of an optimal courtesy dock configuration for either a single-lane or dual-lane layout. At East Harbor State Park campground and marina boat launch, the campground launch scope includes improvements to both launch lanes, evaluation of courtesy docks for repair or replacement, and a visual assessment of the adjacent seawall. The marina launch scope includes full replacement design of the ramp and assessment of abutments for possible repair or replacement, excluding the adjacent boat lift or well.
records.services: A/E services including civil engineering, structural engineering, geotechnical engineering, surveying/GIS/mapping, environmental engineering/planning/design, materials testing, and construction/project management.

records.csv_project_name: Design Services for Campus Wide Assessment
records.title: Design Services for Campus Wide Assessment
records.project_scope: Campus-wide assessment and feasibility study for converting the University of New Mexico heating infrastructure from steam-based systems to electrified low-temperature hot water solutions. Scope includes comparative concepts for individual building conversions and combined building hubs; routing and siting of plants; interconnections and looped distribution configurations; utility and roadway crossings; resiliency, isolation and valving strategies; evaluation of ties to existing plants or future energy centers; and comparison of electric heat sources such as heat recovery chillers, ambient loop heat pumps, thermal storage, and electric boilers. At building level, the consultant must review records and perform field walkthroughs for identified buildings, classify them into Green/Yellow/Red conversion categories, assess residual steam needs, define domestic hot water strategies, and prepare schematic flow diagrams and control narratives. The assignment also includes load analysis, option comparison, phasing plans, and Class 4/5 opinions of probable cost for campus distribution, building conversions, heat-source equipment, controls integration, and commissioning. The study must address reliability, resiliency, decarbonization, lifecycle value, and constructability while protecting academic, research, and patient-care operations.
records.services: Professional A/E design and assessment services including feasibility and concept study, campus energy and utility planning, civil engineering input for distribution corridors and crossings, mechanical engineering for heating electrification concepts, rehabilitation/refurbishment planning, programming, architecture/interior coordination, phasing and constructability planning, cost estimating, and preparation of preliminary alignment drawings, schematic flow diagrams, and implementation plans.

records.project_scope: Consulting services for a structural sustainability survey of Berth 6 at the Port of Pensacola. The facility consists of a steel sheet pile bulkhead wall with concrete cap, approximately 645 ft long, stabilized by about 126 precast prestressed concrete batter piles, and a cast-in-place reinforced concrete dock supported by about 295 precast prestressed 18-inch square piles. Inspection covers the bulkhead wall, battered concrete piles, reinforced concrete cap/wall, and dock piles from mudline to the underside of the dock superstructure. The inspection is to follow the ASCE Waterfront Facilities Inspection and Assessment Manual at Level 1 general visual inspection, with additional inspection if damage is found. Ultrasonic thickness testing of the steel sheet piles is required at every 5th column line or 50 ft, with measurements at top, middle (12-15 ft), and bottom (20-25 ft). Commercial diving services with ADC and FHWA underwater bridge inspection certifications are required, with video documentation available as needed.
